equipment.hardModeAggressiveDesc: Relevant Hard stages at max, Normal fills shortfall
equipment.hardModeOptimizedDesc: Hard minimized separately, Normal covers the rest
equipment.hardModeAggressiveDetail: Runs every Hard stage that drops needed equipment at the maximum daily limit (farming days ×3), then Normal stages fill whatever's left. Maximizes Hard stage usage, but may spend AP farming equipment you already have enough of.
equipment.hardModeOptimizedDetail: Calculates the most efficient Hard stages for your needs first, then Normal stages cover the rest. Because Hard and Normal are planned separately, some AP may be wasted when both stage types share the same drop types — Hard can end up over-running items that Normal could have covered.
equipment.hardModeManualDetail: You set the number of runs for each Hard stage yourself, and Normal stages are automatically calculated to cover remaining needs. Use this when you have a specific Hard schedule in mind or want to fine-tune a plan.
equipment.hardModeCombinedDesc: Hard & Normal planned together, Hard prioritized when equal
equipment.hardModeCombinedDetail: Plans Hard and Normal stages together in a single pass. When efficiency is equal, Hard stages are given priority over Normal in the calculation. Among the three auto modes, this one typically runs the fewest Hard stages.

intro.title: Planner Guide
intro.summary: Calculate expected Pyroxene income based on future schedules, set Pick-Up strategies, and simulate your gacha success rates.
intro.feat1_desc: Predicts available Pyroxenes based on current assets, monthly packs, and future raid schedules.
intro.feat2_desc: Set target students and define detailed strategies like intentional sparking or conditional pulls.
intro.feat3_desc: Analyze success rates and bankruptcy risks by running simulations based on your strategy.
intro.feat4_desc: Check balance trends on the timeline chart, and click student cards to view eleph distributions.

notes.title: Notes & Assumptions
notes.note1_pre: This tool is currently in BETA and is based on this
notes.note1_post: . For perfect accuracy, using the original spreadsheet is recommended.
notes.note2: Grand Assault tickets are assumed to have no expiration date.
notes.note3: Of the Grand Assault rewards, the time-limited 10-pull recruitment ticket is technically granted at 00:00 GMT+9 the next day, but by then a new banner has already opened — if you pull right after that banner opens, you won't be able to use the ticket on it. So this planner assumes only that ticket is acquired at 11:00 GMT+9 on the same day, coinciding with the event's end. Pyroxenes are assumed separately to be acquired on the last day of Grand Assault.
notes.note4: Pyroxenes from maintenance, some stories, PvP resets, Momotalks, and achievements are not individually tracked. To balance this, a default extra income of 1,200 Pyroxenes per month is applied.
notes.note5: All Pyroxene consumption and acquisition from events are assumed to occur on the first day of the event.
notes.note6: Pyroxenes from Total Assault / Grand Assault are assumed to be acquired on the last day of the event.
notes.note7: Events with existing data use manually extracted yields from the spreadsheet. Events without data default to a yield of 1,800 Pyroxenes.
notes.note8: Arona's login bonus assumes today is Day 1.
notes.note9: In the Strategy Tab, if you plan to pull multiple characters from the same banner, please ensure you adjust the 'Max Budget (Max Pity limits)' accordingly.
notes.note10: All 10-pull and single recruitment tickets are converted and calculated as equivalent Pyroxenes (1 pull = 120 Pyroxenes).
